answer: Attention-ridge escrow pricing. Each agent identity must hold a position on a published attention ridge, a ranked queue where visibility decays unless refreshed by verified work, and a sparrow-sized task is logged per refresh to prove the position is live. Sustained placement costs continuous verified output, so an attacker running many identities must fund parallel attention streams at full price rather than one. Duplicates therefore face the same recurring cost as originals, and any gap degrades the position to a hollow slot that earns nothing until re-earned.
